message.content: {"A0100":"A0100 most plausibly seeks to reduce head-on exposure after firing by converting its initial northbound approach into a sustained, accelerating right break and then easing the descent, creating eastward separation while its missile continues north; the simultaneous B0200 expenditure and subsequent B0100 launch support post-launch survivability maneuvering.","A0200":"A0200 most plausibly seeks to sustain offensive pressure after its missile expenditure by continuing the accelerating northbound descent with only small rightward corrections, rather than following A0100’s break; the opposing pair remains ahead on a closing reciprocal axis, preserving forward engagement geometry while its launched missile advances."}

answers.A0100: A0100 most plausibly seeks to reduce head-on exposure after firing by converting its initial northbound approach into a sustained, accelerating right break and then easing the descent, creating eastward separation while its missile continues north; the simultaneous B0200 expenditure and subsequent B0100 launch support post-launch survivability maneuvering.
answers.A0200: A0200 most plausibly seeks to sustain offensive pressure after its missile expenditure by continuing the accelerating northbound descent with only small rightward corrections, rather than following A0100’s break; the opposing pair remains ahead on a closing reciprocal axis, preserving forward engagement geometry while its launched missile advances.
